name: cheat-shoot
title_zh: 拍完一条视频，它替你记下该补拍哪一镜
tagline_zh: 喊声「拍了」就建好素材夹、核对脚本版本、计数入队。不打断拍摄，收工后和发布端对账，漏拍镜头当场现形。
tagline_en: Say "shot" and it files the footage, checks the script, and queues the take. No interruption mid-shoot—reconcile.
desc_en: 登记一条视频已拍摄。**建 video folder + 询问实际拍摄稿是否与 scripts/<id>.md 一致 + buffer +1**。与 cheat-publish 配对：拍了进队列，发了出队列。触发词："拍了"/"拍了 X"/"shot"/"shot it"/"已拍 X"/"录完了"。
why_zh: 把「拍了」这种口头禅变成结构化动作：建目录、比对脚本、递增队列。它不猜你拍了什么，只确认你说了什么。
why_en: Turns a casual "shot" into a structured log: folder created, script diffed, queue bumped. It never guesses—only confirms—so your.
limit_zh: 只认六个触发词，且必须由你亲口说出。不解析视频内容、不识别画面，只做登记与计数。若脚本文件缺失或已改动，它只提醒。
limit_en: Only 6 trigger phrases, spoken by you. No content parsing, no vision—just logging and counting. If script file is missing or edited, it flags, never.
title_en: Log a shot, queue the reshoot you forgot
